Name: (AT)National Day Gift by Song Ke
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][color=#e69138]* 介绍 *[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]*introduce *[/color][/b]

[color=#e69138]国庆节快乐！[/color]
Happy National Day！

[color=#e69138]这是我制作的国庆贺礼，参考了天安门的华表，有原版和红绸缎版，它们替换了游戏里的传送雕像。[/color]
This is a National Day gift I made, referencing the Tiananmen ornamental pillars (huabiao) , there are original and red satin versions, they replace the game's transfer obelisk.

[color=#e69138]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.

————————————————————————————————————
[color=#6aa84f]
[/color][b][color=#6aa84f]* 使用方式 *[/color]
* How to use *[/b]
[color=#6aa84f]
确保下载了[b] SMAPI [/b]和 [b]Alternative Textures[/b]。[/color]
Make sure to download [b]SMAPI[/b] and[b] Alternative Textures[/b].

[color=#6aa84f]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.
[color=#6aa84f]
进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对建筑使用即可。[/color]
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the building to use.

————————————————————————————————

[color=#c27ba0]如果mod出现了问题，可以在小红书上联系我~[/color]
If there is a problem with the mod, you can contact me in the little red book ~

My username：送客
ID：1084538758

[color=#c27ba0]以上英文翻译均来源网络，如有问题请见谅。[/color]
The above English translation is from the Internet, if there are mistakes, please forgive.
